title: isolate.config.json
description: What `isolate apply` resolves in this checkout. Every resolver is enabled when the file or the key is absent.

label.description: Default label for the port offset and compose project name (default: the current branch). --name overrides it.

envPorts.description: Remap KEY=<port> lines in untracked dotenv files.

files.description: Globs (*, ?, **) relative to the checkout root. Default: every untracked .env / .env.* file outside build and dependency directories. Tracked files are always skipped.

keyPattern.description: JavaScript regular expression tested against the key.

composePorts.description: Remap docker compose host ports: ${VAR:-default} ones via VAR in .env, hard-coded ones via a generated override (docker compose >= 2.24).

files.description: Compose files in load order, relative to the checkout root. Default: the primary compose file and its conventional override.
